implementation_summary: Added a barrel with named exports only (no export *). Values: AITimeoutError (from ../../ai/timeout.js); resolveAuditAi, auditAiRequestBudget; AuditAiModelsStore, AUDIT_AI_MODELS_FILE; findClaimWords, hasClaimWords; IMPACT_EFFORT_BY_RULE, IMPACT_EFFORT_BY_SEVERITY, DEFAULT_IMPACT_EFFORT, WHOLE_PAGE_RULES, defaultImpactEffort, scoreFindings, rankFindings, rankFindingsWithIdMap, checkCitations; measurePageSpeed, measureSampleSpeeds, mapPsiResponse, isQuotaAnswer, psiRequestUrl, PSI_ENDPOINT, PSI_TIMEOUT_MS, PSI_MAX_BYTES; assessPages, assessSite; recommendPages, recommendationFor, ruleRecommendation, REDESIGN_MIN_HIGH_IMPACT, REDESIGN_MIN_GROUPS, REDESIGN_LOW_AREAS, NO_FINDINGS_REASON; findOverlaps, overlapThreshold, overlapWords, writeRewrite, rewriteMessages; RewriteStore, REWRITES_FILE. Also exports each module's public types. The ADR 0018 word-list constants are deliberately not re-exported (they belong to documents/wording.ts) to avoid ambiguous star exports later. The test checks every expected export exists, that re-exports are the same objects as their source modules, and that no name collides with the core barrel. Before BE-190 no barrel name may exist in core; after BE-190 every name must reach core as the same object.

tests_proposed: After BE-190, run pnpm build to confirm the core barrel's export * of audit/ai has no TS2308 ambiguity.
evidence: packages/core/tests/audit-ai-barrel.test.ts collision test: 'has no runtime export that collides with the core barrel'
risks: The collision test imports the whole core barrel (src/index.ts), so a load-time error anywhere in core would make it fail.
The ADR 0018 word lists (ADR_0018_CLAIM_WORDS, CLAIM_WORDS, RELEASE_VERDICT_WORDS) are not in the barrel; callers needing them import claim-words.ts or documents/wording.ts directly.
overlapWords and rewriteMessages are exported because they are module exports of rewrite.ts; a reviewer may consider them internal.
handoff: BE-190: add `export * from './audit/ai/index.js'` to packages/core/src/index.ts. The barrel test then switches mode and requires every barrel name to reach core as the same object. If a name clashes, the test lists it and the build reports TS2308; rename or narrow the export in the audit barrel. Import AITimeoutError from the core barrel or from audit/ai/index.ts.
